page.overview:
What is Witch's Broom?

A witch's broom is an item which enables magic users to fly. Broom flight is taught to magic users in Elfhelm according to their respective skill levels. To fly, the user-to-be needs to deal with barytes, something that might be difficult to those with a serious disposition. Molda claims to be the best at broom flight in all of Skellig, going for a ride when bored during lectures.

These wooden items can be used for flight transportation and, more mundanely, for whacking or as cleaning tools.
